explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and is nonzero only at GO, where it follows the clock whatever the rewards or transitions were; choosing a2 adds a little late in the episode.
old_explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and is nonzero only at GO, where it acts like a clock that rises with trial number whatever the rewards or transitions were: about 0 before trial 60, about 1 at trials 60-70, 2 around trial 75, 3-4 around 80-86, 5-6 around 87-92, 7-8 at 93-94 and 9-10 from trial 95 on. Choosing a2 adds about 1 point late in the episode, so a GO with a2 after trial 95 is 10.
